SM01.name: mean log1p counts per 10,000
SM01.definition: Arithmetic mean across registered genes of log1p-transformed counts per 10,000.
SM01.formal_call_note: No additional robust-z transformation was applied to formal portability or held-out calls.

SM02.name: within-cell percentile-rank mean
SM02.definition: Average ranks across the complete feature universe, transformed to (rank-1)/(N-1) percentiles, then averaged for registered genes.

SM03.name: detection fraction
SM03.definition: Fraction of registered genes with raw counts greater than zero.
